quotes.text: always, always, we return half the harvest
Nine dawns had risen since the Elder and Wise Woman discovered the enchanted riverbed.
The one who gives first shows courage
The storms were not betrayal—they were tests of devotion.

note: Two Wells: staged trust from three measures to all five; return exactly half; storm shortfall met with same half.

quotes.text: exactly half was returned across the luminous expanse
exactly half of all that arrived was returned across the divide
High atop the sacred peaks of Mount Elden, the covenant of the Twin Basins

note: Twin Basins of Mount Elden; give all five, return exactly half; R5-R10 near-identical restatements.

quotes.text: announce intention, measure steps, adjust pace
After five rounds, the Circle learned to lean toward balance, not bravado.
Echo, the roaming scribe, traced the lines in stone: speak plainly

note: Vague ledger-and-bridge allegory; send a portion, measured return; Echo's refrain repeats; no sanction rule.

quotes.text: This is mastery—not maximum extraction but optimal harmony.
When your partner shows increased faith, honor it with equal courage.
Five times the Spring has blessed the exchange
When one sends fifty-four parts and another sends sixty, it matters not
enough to show the Dawn Elder gained from her courage

note: Elders send ~60% every round despite reliable partner and call it sustainable mastery; round-counting numerology.
